nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It was the night before school started...
Kimi leads her mother and sister into the campus auditorium. The walls are covered in glitter, and a big banner overhead reads 'Back to School Fashion Show!'

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: This is it!

nodes.speaker: Lily
nodes.text: So pretty!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: In about twenty minutes, this place will be packed for the show, and the models will come out wearing my outfits!

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Chen
nodes.text: Your outfits are coming out first? Are they not as good as the other designers'?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: They're coming out in random order. Anyway, that's not important. What's important is that `my` designs are coming out!
nodes.text_bbcode: They're coming out in random order. Anyway, that's not important. What's important is that [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] designs are coming out!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: And I just wanted to thank you, Mom. I couldn't have done it without you.

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Chen
nodes.text: No! You held up your end of the bargain, getting those good grades in summer school!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Well, some classes definitely weren't easy... Or normal.
Later, backstage, as the fashion show is about to begin...
Kimi watches nervously as her models line up to walk the runway. Someone taps her on the shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Showrunner
nodes.text: Excuse me, Miss Chen?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yes?

nodes.speaker: Showrunner
nodes.text: Are these your designs?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Is there a problem?

nodes.speaker: Showrunner
nodes.text: Uh... Yes! These outfits violate the school dress code!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What? How?

nodes.speaker: Showrunner
nodes.text: Where to begin! Not only are you using unapproved hats...

nodes.speaker: Showrunner
nodes.text: But I can see entirely too much of these models' legs!

nodes.speaker: Showrunner
nodes.text: Plus a bare midriff or two!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: But this is a fashion show, not a school day!

nodes.speaker: Showrunner
nodes.text: Still, the rules apply. The last thing we want is for the parents attending this show to think we condone this kind of attire.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: That's ridiculous! They're dressed normal!

nodes.speaker: Showrunner
nodes.text: They're dressed inappropriately!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Well, what am I supposed to do?! My models are supposed to go out in two minutes!
Brinna clears her throat and steps forward...

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: I couldn't help but overhear... If Kimi's outfits are a problem, my models are ready.

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: I don't want to be mean and say that my designs are better than hers or anything, but they are more appealing to the eye.
The showrunner glances over at some of Brinna's more conservative designs, long skirts and formal suits, and smiles warmly.

nodes.speaker: Showrunner
nodes.text: Yes, how delightful. Those will do.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: But those are grandma clothes!

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: Excuse me?!

nodes.speaker: Showrunner
nodes.text: `I` find them very stylish!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] find them very stylish!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: That's kind of the point.
The showrunner huffs off.
Brinna begins lining her models up in front of Kimi's.

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: Okay, models wearing Kimi's eyesores, please make way for my sensible line of clothes.
Kimi peeks out at the audience from behind a curtain...
Kimi spins, facing Brinna!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Stop!

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: What do you mean, 'stop'?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I mean just that, stop. `My` models are going out!
nodes.text_bbcode: I mean just that, stop. [color=#3b78e2][i]My[/i][/color] models are going out!

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: Are you an idiot or something? The showrunner just said you couldn't do that.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: So what? I'm `disobeying` the showrunner.
nodes.text_bbcode: So what? I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]disobeying[/i][/color] the showrunner.

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: You... You can't do that.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Watch me!
Kimi scrambles to get her models back in the front of the line...
A few seconds later...
The show begins, and the first model struts down the runway in a short skirt!
But, the showrunner leaps out from backstage!

nodes.speaker: Showrunner
nodes.text: No! The school does not approve!
She bundles the model up in a blanket and pulls her backstage to the gasps of the audience!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What are you doing?!

nodes.speaker: Showrunner
nodes.text: Canceling the show! You're in `big` trouble!
nodes.text_bbcode: Canceling the show! You're in [color=#3b78e2][i]big[/i][/color] trouble!

nodes.text: After most of the audience has cleared out, Kimi meets up with her mother and sister...

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Chen
nodes.text: What's going on? What happened to the show?!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: They canceled it because my designs are too 'risque.'

nodes.speaker: Lily
nodes.text: What? No way! I thought that one design was really pretty!

nodes.speaker: Lily
nodes.text: I think... I mean, I only saw it for like a second.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Prettiness wasn't the issue... At least, I don't `think` it was... I just know that I'm in trouble.
nodes.text_bbcode: Prettiness wasn't the issue... At least, I don't [color=#3b78e2][i]think[/i][/color] it was... I just know that I'm in trouble.

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Chen
nodes.text: I see. Maybe this is a sign you should take your studies a little more seriously.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Thanks, Mom.

nodes.text: Oh my gosh! I heard they canceled the show because Kimi was going to make all the models walk out in their `underwear!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh my gosh! I heard they canceled the show because Kimi was going to make all the models walk out in their [color=#3b78e2][i]underwear![/i][/color]

nodes.text: So the show got canceled?

nodes.text: Yup. And as punishment for violating the dress code, I got sent here.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I also had to promise not to do any designing until after I served my sentence...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: No makeovers allowed.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: That's a weird punishment.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: The school's just making an example of me.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: So even though I want to help with the clothing drive, I can't.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Well, at least it wasn't `all` bad, right?
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, at least it wasn't [color=#3b78e2][i]all[/i][/color] bad, right?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I mean, according to Paige, you're `the` fashion queen of Twin Branches!
nodes.text_bbcode: I mean, according to Paige, you're [color=#3b78e2][i]the[/i][/color] fashion queen of Twin Branches!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: That means the Fashion Show must have been a big success!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It was.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: See!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: But for all the wrong reasons...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: How so?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: The student body knows me now as someone who designs risque clothes, but my clothes weren't even that scandalous!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: They only know me for what happened, not for my designs.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: The allure of the taboo?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I don't know what that means, but it sounds right...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I mean, I've already had my taste of fame for fame's sake. I want to be known for designing stylish clothes!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I see...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Want to know the worst part?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Brinna, the girl I was competing with...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Yes?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: ...She's way better than me.
$ALLISON struggles to find something to say...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I wish I knew what to tell you...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It's okay. Sometimes when something's wrong, it can't get fixed.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You can't help me, and I can't help the Troublemakers.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: That is really sad...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Come on. I think you'll feel better if you talk about it...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: How was that?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Much better.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: But do you actually want to know what's going on? Or are you just here because you feel like you're supposed to be?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I feel like it's always cathartic to tell the truth... Especially if that truth is weighing on you.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: And if I can be integral in improving your well-being by listening to your story, here I am!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Thanks... If that's true, then what I'm about to tell you should make me feel a whole lot better...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Though I doubt it...

nodes.text: You really suck at this, you know?

nodes.text: What do you...?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Wait... Who'd Kimi give makeovers to?!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: You haven't seen them yet?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: We don't have to see them...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Are you crazy?! Why are we still talking?! Why am I not seeing them now?!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Come on, I'll show you...
In the theater, Andrew stands on stage in full clown makeup, practicing a monologue.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: It is with this heavy heart, that I cry, not tears of sadness, but tears of pure happiness.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: For at last, my love returns to me!
He stops when he sees the Troublemakers...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Ah, joy! I cannot thank thee enough, fair Kimi.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It was nothing.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Nothing! Ha! Did Michaelangelo shrug at the Sistine Chapel?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Did Shakespeare blush at the mediocrities of Hamlet?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: No! And neither should you at your masterpiece!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Does this mean that the play's back on?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Of course! 'Andrew: A Glimpse of Greatness' premieres this weekend!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Well, thank you for donating so many clothes!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: It was an exchange for the ages. A few clothes for my dream fulfilled!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Now leave me be!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Break a leg!
In the bleachers at the football field, the cheerleaders are all gossiping excitedly!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: So then, what'd `he` say?!
nodes.text_bbcode: So then, what'd [color=#3b78e2][i]he[/i][/color] say?!

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Yeah, Nicole, tell me he said what I think he said!
They stop when the Troublemakers arrive...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: What are you doing here? This is a closed practice!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I just wanted to show everyone Nicole's makeover...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Oh... Isn't it awesome?!
Maria and Lindsay move aside, revealing Nicole's 'bubblegum pop star' look! Nicole twirls in a beautiful, bright, glittery dress!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I love it!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Wow!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Seriously. Wow.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You look amazing!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: That's what my date said when `he` saw me! We have another date tonight!
nodes.text_bbcode: That's what my date said when [color=#3b78e2][i]he[/i][/color] saw me! We have another date tonight!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'd go on another date with you!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But I guess I'd have to go on a first one first...

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Anyway, we're talking here! Er... Practicing!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Come on... There's still one more makeover!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: We don't have to see `all` of them!
nodes.text_bbcode: We don't have to see [color=#3b78e2][i]all[/i][/color] of them!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh yes, we so do!
In the library, the nerds are arguing over the distribution of treasure.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Dex the Purple and Wise deserves more of the treasure because he's better than everyone else!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: A compelling, selfish reason from Dex.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: How about we split it because that's actually fair?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Why don't we calculate what percentage of damage we did to the dragon and take treasure according to who did the most?
Paige nudges $ALLISON...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I see Brendan, Dex, Ashley, Kevin, and that blond nerd, but where's Taylor?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I `heard` that!
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]heard[/i][/color] that!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: OMG! Taylor's the blond nerd!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yah! The apocalypse is here!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I never thought I'd see the day.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah... What he said.
Taylor turns to Brendan...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I hope you're happy! You see what I put up with just to make you happy!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I do, I do! And that's why I love you!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Okay, you're cool. I love you too!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Well, this is quite emotionally rich!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: You did a superlative job on these makeovers, Kimi.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Thanks... I don't think I could've done them without your help, $ALLISON.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Well, what are `friends` for, right?
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, what are [color=#3b78e2][i]friends[/i][/color] for, right?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: We're friends now, right?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I called us friends, but I'm concerned that maybe I overstepped my bounds. After all--

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Wow. Take a breath! We're friends!
Kimi gives $ALLISON a big hug!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Heh. Oof.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: $ALLISON? I didn't know you had any design skills!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Well... Surprise!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: This is quite a shock. I don't--
Spencer stands up.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Actually, I designed those clothes!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Spencer?! Now I `know` you don't have any--
nodes.text_bbcode: Spencer?! Now I [color=#3b78e2][i]know[/i][/color] you don't have any--

nodes.text: Owen and Paige stand up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I designed those clothes!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No, `I` designed those clothes!
nodes.text_bbcode: No, [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] designed those clothes!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, the good-looking ones at least.
Erik stands.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I am Kimi Chen!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I mean... `I` designed those clothes!
nodes.text_bbcode: I mean... [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] designed those clothes!

nodes.text: Ms. Lee glares at the Troublemakers.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Very shady, all of you...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: But what the heck! The students that got made over look so incredible, I just can't punish you.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Now get out of here before I change my mind!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I `am` Kimi Chen.
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]am[/i][/color] Kimi Chen.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Oh no... It's happening again...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: $ALLISON, what are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: It's just like that one classic movie. Everyone stands up and claims to be the same person...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: If we're all guilty, she can't single out one of us!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: So who's with me?!
No one stands up.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Uh oh...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: I think I understand what's going on here...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: You do?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Yes! This whole time I embarrassingly thought she was Kimi and you were $ALLISON!
Ms. Lee turns to Kimi...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Please forgive me, $ALLISON.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Uh, no problem!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Kimi!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: As for you, Miss Chen, you are in all kinds of hot water!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: But... I... I'm $ALLISON.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Oh no, that's not going to work on me again!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Fool me once, shame on you.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Fool me twice, get suspended.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I don't know if that's really a phrase...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: It doesn't really matter. The point is...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I'm suspended...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Yup! Next time don't disobey school orders!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: And try to avoid identity swapping!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Good tip...
$ALLISON rises from her chair, too sad to look any of her classmates in the eye...
As she leaves Ms. Lee's office, headed home to serve her suspension, she knows that...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Awful...
Owen reaches deep down into the nearly empty bin, rummaging through some ratty shirts and old socks, and pulls out a piece of paper.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What's it say?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Is it an I.O.U. for 500 pieces of clothing?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It says, 'We were going to donate. But then we saw those lame prizes.'

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What kind of a person refuses to donate their clothes out of spite?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So... What? I'm going to be doing this dumb clothing drive for the rest of my life?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: For a while at least... A `long` while...
nodes.text_bbcode: For a while at least... A [color=#e23b3b][i]long[/i][/color] while...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Let's face it... Without Kimi's makeover rewards, we're doomed!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Paige is right... There's got to be a way to get Kimi onboard!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You know, we'd be better off if you guys had tried harder in the cafeteria! A little salesmanship might have made a difference! How hard is it to tell a few white lies?!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: He's very health-minded. He loves raisins.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I like to pretend they're vacuum-packed grapes!
The crowd is silent.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Uh, he's strange. You never know what he's going to say next!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well, now there's a lot of pressure on me...
Still nothing from the crowd...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Uh, he's... A nerd?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Psst! I told you we should have skipped this part!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: And if I had a time travel device, I would go back and listen to you!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Erik's going to be completely ashamed!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well, that's okay! I've got enough friends!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Owe-dog, move 'er along!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh, whatever you say!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What about you, Erik? What prize are you offering up?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'm glad you asked, Owe-dog! I'm offering up a free day of friendship!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh huh... And what makes that special?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well, um... Uh... You get to be friends... With me... And stuff... Like that.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Okay, friends with Erik. I think we can just skip the hand-raising part and...
$ALLISON raises her hand. Owen speaks to her under his breath...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What are you doing? You're going to embarrass him!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Trust me...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I, for one, am excited by the prospect of a day as Erik's friend. Think of all the benefits!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: After all, Erik is...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: She may seem mean, rude, and selfish...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: And she is...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: But she's also `the` person you want with you on a shopping trip.
nodes.text_bbcode: But she's also [color=#3b78e2][i]the[/i][/color] person you want with you on a shopping trip.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: After all, it was my shopping trip with Paige that got me this outfit!
$ALLISON does a quick twirl, her skirt flaring out.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What shopping trip?!
$ALLISON shoots Paige a knowing look.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh yeah, I remember now!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: The moment Paige told me I actually looked good in something...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I knew she meant it.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That's right. I did.
A few more hands raise...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: All right. Good points, $ALLISON.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: This is your chance to get a whole new outfit!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: So our choice is to happily shop for clothes by ourselves...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Or miserably shop with her?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: You have brought up a point that is very valid and surprising.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What?! You should be defending me!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Uh... I have no retort!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Wow. Today really is the best!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Okay, next up! Paige!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Look! What do you care about helping the needy?! Nothing, right? Or you would have donated already!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You obviously love the clothes you have, but all of you dress like slobs!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So the trick is to get better clothes, so you can donate the hideous ones you're wearing!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: That is an unexpected angle...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: If you're in the top spot, you get to buy clothes with me.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I get `at least` a pair of shoes out of the day, and `you're` carrying all the bags!
nodes.text_bbcode: I get [color=#3b78e2][i]at least[/i][/color] a pair of shoes out of the day, and [color=#3b78e2][i]you're[/i][/color] carrying all the bags!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So, uh, raise your hand if you're interested in that...
No one moves... An awkward silence fills the air.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: { Somebody saaaaaay something... {
$ALLISON raises her hand.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I, for one, am interested. After all, the real prize here is...
$ALLISON raises her hand!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I know it's going to be intense, but I also know it's going to be... Um... Fun!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That's one! Who else?
Soon other hands start to tentatively raise into the air...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Awesome! All you have to do is crush the clothing drive! If you're in one of the top spots for donations, we'll set up a pain meeting!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That sounds, uh, lovely.
$ALLISON keeps her hand down... The rest of the cafeteria is just as still.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Well fine! If you don't want your rump shaped, I don't want to know you!
Spencer sits back down, fuming.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Spencer, are you upset because no one likes your prize? Or because this is your default state?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Shut up.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I see...
The next day at lunch, all the Troublemakers but Kimi are sitting at a table...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You're sure she's not coming?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: After our conversation, it's unlikely.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Is everybody down to do what we're about to do?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I don't want to, but I'll do anything to get out of this stupid community service punishment.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What about you, Weirdo?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'm jittery as a nervousbug! Er, jervous as a nitterbug!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Right. No more caffeine for you. Come on, let's do this!
The Troublemakers stand up, and Owen calls out!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Everyone! If I could have your attention, please!
The whole cafeteria stops and stares...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: We're running a clothing drive! We know that we've done drives in the past with little success...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But we're spicing this one up! The top donors will receive some amazing prizes! Such as...
Owen points to Spencer...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yesssss! Who wants to feel the ultimate pain?!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Who wants to feel the most grueling, the most intense, the most rib-cracking, rump-shaping, bicep-bursting workout of your weak and pathetic lives?!
No one raises their hand...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Show of hands? Anyone?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Okay, that about wraps it up!
The cafeteria crowd applauds politely.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Thanks for listening, everyone! Enjoy your lunches!
Owen whispers to the Troublemakers.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: We'll check the donation bin tomorrow morning and see if that made a difference.
The next morning, the team gathers around the donation bin...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: How's it look?
$ALLISON suddenly remembers how Kimi advocated telling a white lie to cover for Owen in Ms. Lee's office...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Kimi taught me that... She said, 'It's what friends do!'
A lightbulb flips on in $ALLISON's head!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: That's how we'll get her to help us! We'll tell Ms. Lee a white lie!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You okay?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Yes! Please do me a favor... Just meet me here in ten minutes... And...
$ALLISON leans in, whispering her plan to the Troublemakers. A moment later...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Will you help me? Is that copacetic?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Copa-what?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'll do what you're asking, even though I don't understand it... Or that word.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Perfect! Thanks!
$ALLISON takes off, searching for Kimi!
$ALLISON finds Kimi outside, sitting on the steps again, eating her lunch alone...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Eating in isolation seems more like something `I` would do, Kimi.
nodes.text_bbcode: Eating in isolation seems more like something [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] would do, Kimi.

nodes.text: Kimi imitates $ALLISON's voice...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Hey, Kimi, you're acting like a socially incompetent freshman. Feel better?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Good point. That was not my best effort.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I'm new at this, remember?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah. Have a seat, Dr. $ALLISON.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Actually, I have a better idea.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What is it?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Come with me...
Kimi gets up and follows $ALLISON.
$ALLISON and Kimi walk down the hall...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: We've gotten some donations for the clothing drive, but not nearly as many as we'd get with your help.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I told you. I `can't` design. And even if I did, I'm kind of... Over the whole fashion thing.
nodes.text_bbcode: I told you. I [color=#3b78e2][i]can't[/i][/color] design. And even if I did, I'm kind of... Over the whole fashion thing.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What if I told you that I could handle your problems with the school restrictions?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I don't see how, but--

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: If I did, would you design new outfits for the top donors?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: That'd be nice of you, but I told you. I'm done with fashion.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: That's lunacy! It's just a matter of your confidence...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Did you know the root of the word confidence comes from a Latin word meaning trust?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Does `anybody` know that?
nodes.text_bbcode: Does [color=#3b78e2][i]anybody[/i][/color] know that?

nodes.text: $ALLISON and Kimi turn the corner...
The Troublemakers are all there, each one wearing an outfit from Kimi's fashion show.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Ohmigosh! You guys!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: We trust you, Kimi.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Awwwww!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Is Erik wearing one of my dresses?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I am more comfortable than I expected to be.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: So? What do you say?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: If you've got me covered...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: How could I say no?!
A week later, in Ms. Lee's office...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: 1,024 pieces of clothing! I never thought you could pull it off!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: I mean, I really had no faith in you.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: All it took was our rewards program! Specifically, offering up makeovers to our top donors!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: It's your happiness that just makes it so much harder to discuss what I'm about to discuss.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: If you say we have to do `another` clothing drive, I will rip out everyone's hair, including my own!
nodes.text_bbcode: If you say we have to do [color=#3b78e2][i]another[/i][/color] clothing drive, I will rip out everyone's hair, including my own!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: No, it's not that. It's a disciplinary matter.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Kimi, you were forbidden to design any clothes as part of your punishment.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: From the quality of the makeovers, I can only assume this was your doing.
Kimi hangs her head...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Thus, I have `no` choice but to suspend you. Much as it pains me...
nodes.text_bbcode: Thus, I have [color=#3b78e2][i]no[/i][/color] choice but to suspend you. Much as it pains me...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Ms. Lee...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Yes?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And whose fault is that?!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I did say that Andrew rehearses in the middle of the day...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Sorry, guys. I forgot.
Outside the theater...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, we didn't get what we wanted...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: You simpletons! Disturbing my rehearsal for yet another pitiful clothing drive!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Begone, the lot of you!
The Troublemakers flee!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: There are prizes!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Imagine a toothbrush with `your` initials on it.
nodes.text_bbcode: Imagine a toothbrush with [color=#3b78e2][i]your[/i][/color] initials on it.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: So since you rudely interrupted me, you `must` have something important to discuss!
nodes.text_bbcode: So since you rudely interrupted me, you [color=#e23b3b][i]must[/i][/color] have something important to discuss!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh... Would the drama club... Or you, I guess... Want to participate in a clothing drive?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Why?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: In the climactic third act, I'm to look the part of a sad clown, but our makeup and wardrobe team did not have the chops for such a task. Hacks!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: If I can't look the part, if I can't immerse myself into the role, I have no vehicle with which to transform...
A few minutes later, the Troublemakers step into the campus theater...
Andrew is onstage, performing a monologue...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: For I, the sad clown, must admit my follies, my mistakes, my many flaws.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Made all the more tragic with a squeak of my red nose.
Andrew reaches up to honk a pretend red nose, but stops when he sees the Troublemakers...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Cut! Cut!
Andrew runs over and flips on the lights!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Idiots! How could you interrupt my performance?! It was the one time I felt nearly, barely, almost like I `was` my character!
nodes.text_bbcode: Idiots! How could you interrupt my performance?! It was the one time I felt nearly, barely, almost like I [color=#e23b3b][i]was[/i][/color] my character!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: We're sorry... It's just that--

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Just that you have no respect for the theater, for the drama club, for me!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Where `is` the drama club? Don't you have more members?
nodes.text_bbcode: Where [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] the drama club? Don't you have more members?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: We would! But my show, 'Andrew: A Glimpse of Greatness', has been canceled!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Looks like we blew it by talking to the nerds first!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I thought I mentioned that being an issue...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: You did. I just...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Forgot a crucial piece of information?!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Yeah, pretty much.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Sorry, guys...
Afterward, in the hall...

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: No! Why would we help people who think nerds are better than us!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Get your priorities straight, then we'll talk!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Bye.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: They don't even wear real clothes.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: They just go around naked?

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Ew. That's so `so` wrong, Nicole!
nodes.text_bbcode: Ew. That's so [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] wrong, Nicole!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: So... Will you help us out?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Relax, relax. Second, we were sort of in the middle of a convo when you sat down.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: An `important` convo.
nodes.text_bbcode: An [color=#3b78e2][i]important[/i][/color] convo.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: About what?!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: About my look! I'm thinking about getting a total makeover, but I'm not sure what kind of look I should go with.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You're interrupting us to talk about a makeover? I don't think anyone here actually cares about--

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Oh. My. Gosh! You should totally do it! You would look so good as, like, a bubblegum pop star!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: What's that?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I don't even know! I just made it up right now! You'd have pink and blue hair and sparkles and like--
Kimi suddenly realizes that everyone's looking at her. She shrinks back.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Um, I mean, someone else can make you over, I'm sure.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Someone else? Why not you?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Who cares about all this makeover stuff?! Will. You. Help. Us?!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Well, first we just want to say we know you talked to the nerds before you talked to us.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Not cool.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Super not cool.
Outside, the Troublemakers sit down next to the cheerleaders on the bleachers.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: We heard about your clothing drive.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: How'd you find out?

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Pfft. Hello? We're cheerleaders. We hear about stuff before it even happens.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Will you help us out?
Afterwards...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: It looks like our fears were just validated. No one's interested in a clothing drive.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: What are we gonna do?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Relax, Erik, we just have to think of another way to generate interest...
Just then, a sophomore girl in a perfectly fitted, exquisitely matched, one-of-a-kind outfit turns the corner.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh, look at that girl! I bet she's `way` into fashion!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, look at that girl! I bet she's [color=#e23b3b][i]way[/i][/color] into fashion!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: So?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: So?! She might have lots of clothes to donate for the drive!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oh, right. Let's get her over here!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I don't know if that's such a good--

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yoo hoo! Over here!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: --Idea...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Something wrong between you and Brinna?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You might say that...
Brinna walks over toward them, but stops short when she sees Kimi, her eyes narrowing.

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: Kimi... Haven't seen you since the fashion show. Can't say I'm disappointed you got punished.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What did I do to you?

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: Like you don't know!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I don't!

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: The Fashion Show? That was `my` opportunity to shine, and you ruined it with your tired, lazy designs!
nodes.text_bbcode: The Fashion Show? That was [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] opportunity to shine, and you ruined it with your tired, lazy designs!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Whoa! Where did Miss Attitude come from?!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I had to take a chance, Brinna. And now `I'm` living with the consequences.
nodes.text_bbcode: I had to take a chance, Brinna. And now [color=#3b78e2][i]I'm[/i][/color] living with the consequences.

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: You don't think I've suffered?! No one knows who I am! But they all know who `you` are.
nodes.text_bbcode: You don't think I've suffered?! No one knows who I am! But they all know who [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] are.

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: Everyone's talking about Kimi Chen's `ridiculous` fashion!
nodes.text_bbcode: Everyone's talking about Kimi Chen's [color=#3b78e2][i]ridiculous[/i][/color] fashion!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'm sorry, okay?

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: Please. You can stuff your apology back into your face.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'm just trying to be nice...

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: Well, you're not. You're selfish, and you know it.
Tears form in Kimi's eyes, and she runs off. Brinna shrugs and walks away.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Someone should probably go talk to Kimi...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, not me. A girl...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'll do it.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: A `different` girl. Someone with more... `Tact...`
nodes.text_bbcode: A [color=#e23b3b][i]different[/i][/color] girl. Someone with more... [color=#e23b3b][i]Tact...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What are you saying?!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I... I guess I'll go talk to her...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I'm so nervous! I don't really know Kimi! Why did I have to be the girl with tact?!
Outside, $ALLISON finds Kimi sitting on some steps...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Hello, Kimi.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I don't want to talk about it. So if you came to figure out what's going on, you're wasting your time.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I see. That's exactly why I came, so I guess I'll just leave you be then.
$ALLISON turns around, relieved.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Wait! What are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Leaving... Or, have I misplayed this?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You're supposed to insist on listening to me anyway!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Oh...
$ALLISON returns to Kimi and sits down next to her.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I'm not very good at these subtle interactions. Most of my bonding experiences have been with my sister Amanda, so they haven't exactly been normal.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I can imagine...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: So, do you want to talk about what's going on with you and Brinna then?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: No, not really.
The Troublemakers find the nerds playing Ogres 'N' Elves in the library...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I just rolled another 20!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Can we use a different set of dice? I call shenanigans.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: It's official. Dex the Wise and Purple is too wise and too purple for his majestic robes!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Your mana is now fully restored.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Then I cast Irritating Sound Wave!
The nerds groan!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: The air is now pierced with a sound so irritating, no creature can withstand it! Everyone on the battlefield writhes in annoyance!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: When this ends, Taylor the Swift is putting one of her arrows through your character, Dex! All this does is waste time!
$ALLISON nudges Kimi. She gestures at Taylor, who looks distinct and different from the nerds, her hair done, her clothes stylish.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Why does she not look like them?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I heard that. And I don't look like a nerd because I'm not one.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, okay... It's hard to say that while I'm rolling a 12-sided die... But I'm also wearing designer jeans, so yeah.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: My girlfriend's still kind of a hybrid of cool and nerd. She's still set in her old ways...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Wait... Are you embarrassed by my cool side?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: How could I be embarrassed to have a hot girlfriend?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I appreciate the compliment... But that's not really an answer.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well... Maybe you could look the part a little more... It's weird when we're all going to a convention together...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: No one takes us serious as nerds!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I can't believe this. You want me to actually `look` nerdy?
nodes.text_bbcode: I can't believe this. You want me to actually [color=#3b78e2][i]look[/i][/color] nerdy?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You don't have to. But...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But?!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But I think you'd look good.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: As opposed to how I look now?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh, time for a break, guys?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yes, please! Everyone's in agony in the game... And some of us in real life, so, yeah! Perfect timing! What's up?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: We're running a clothing drive.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It's going to be splendid! Hot cocoa for the highest donors! And a box of raisins for the top spot!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: That sounds nice. Unfortunately, Dex's mom is running a clothing drive, and we sort of promised we'd donate.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: That `is` unfortunate... Well, save any clothes you don't donate to the other drive...
nodes.text_bbcode: That [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] unfortunate... Well, save any clothes you don't donate to the other drive...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: ...And donate them to us...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hey, Master of Logic. Let's go. This is pointless.
The Troublemakers leave...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Kimi, you were forbidden to design any clothes as part of your punishment.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: From the quality of the makeovers, I can only assume this was your doing.
Kimi hangs her head...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Thus, I have `no` choice but to suspend you. Much as it pains me...
nodes.text_bbcode: Thus, I have [color=#3b78e2][i]no[/i][/color] choice but to suspend you. Much as it pains me...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Ms. Lee...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Yes?
The next day at lunch, all the Troublemakers but Kimi are sitting at a table...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You're sure she's not coming?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: After our conversation, it's unlikely.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Is everybody down to do what we're about to do?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I don't want to, but I'll do anything to get out of this stupid community service punishment.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What about you, Weirdo?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'm jittery as a nervousbug! Er, jervous as a nitterbug!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Right. No more caffeine for you. Come on, let's do this!
The Troublemakers stand up, and Owen calls out!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Everyone! If I could have your attention, please!
The whole cafeteria stops and stares...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: We're running a clothing drive! We know that we've done drives in the past with little success...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But we're spicing this one up! The top donors will receive some amazing prizes! Such as...
Owen points to Spencer...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yesssss! Who wants to feel the ultimate pain?!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Who wants to feel the most grueling, the most intense, the most rib-cracking, rump-shaping, bicep-bursting workout of your weak and pathetic lives?!
No one raises their hand...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Show of hands? Anyone?

I have that effect on people.
Dom steps out of the shadow of a streetlamp, holding a baseball bat.

Say hi to Grammy for me.

A few minutes later, the Troublemakers step into the campus theater...
Andrew is sitting alone in a director's chair on stage, dwarfed by a giant wooden backdrop depicting his face.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Hark! What light through yonder window breaks? Why, if it isn't the wrongdoers! The mislabeled miscreants!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I knew you'd all come here eventually. The call of the theater, of Andrew, cannot be denied.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I assume you're here to sneak a peek at my upcoming performance in 'Andrew: A Glimpse of Greatness'... Right?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh, yeah. We wanted to glimpse greatness before we saw A Glimpse of Greatness.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Verily. But, unfortunately, sadly, `tragically,` the show has been canceled...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Anyway, it cheers me to see you, to see that theater still has hope at this sad hour...

nodes.speaker: Owen

nodes.text: I wish I had the verve, the spunk, the charisma to carry out such a noble task...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: But alas, I'm afraid my life's turned too tragic to think of others. I cannot assist you...

nodes.speaker: Owen

nodes.text: What's so good about it?!

nodes.text: Oh. My. Gosh! You would look so good as, like, a bubblegum pop star!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Ugh. You're too excited this early in the morning. What's a... Gum star?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I don't even know! I just made it up right now! You'd have pink and blue hair and sparkles and this bright dress, like--
Kimi suddenly realizes that everyone's looking at her. She shrinks back.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Um, I mean, someone else can make you over, I'm sure.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Anyway, will you help us with the drive?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Does it look like we'll help you?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No...

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: There's your answer! Go away!
Afterward, in the hall...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I thought you said you knew the answer, $ALLISON...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I thought I did... It's possible the warning about seeing the cheerleaders in the morning slipped my mind...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Nice going.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I told you it wouldn't be pretty...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I feel like I need a shower after that!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Cheerleaders in a bad mood are no joke!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Well, first we just want to say we know you chose to talk to us before talking to the nerds.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Which means you've got your priorities straight.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: No. But thanks for asking!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Buh-bye!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Bye now!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That went about as expected.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Cheerleaders can be so annoying!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Honestly, that's the best mood we could've gotten them in.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Even if it wasn't quite the result we wanted, good job on the logic, $ALLISON.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Thanks!

nodes.text: I don't know about all of you, but I hope we get assigned a task like last week's! I thoroughly enjoyed animal care!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Me too! I adopted a chinchilla! His name's Peanut. I named him after my strongest allergy!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey, Weirdo. Keep your weirdo things to your weirdo self.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What about that dog you picked up, Owen? How's he doing?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hamlet? Well, he tore up my Grandma's couch, slobbered all over my notebook, and decided the best place to sleep last night was on my face...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So it's safe to say he's having a great time.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Gross.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What's the matter? Not a dog enthusiast?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No, dogs are all right. I was actually talking about Owen's face.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You're really going there?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey, man, before you and Metal Detector get into it again, want to tell me what happened yesterday?! You never showed!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh, yeah... I'm sorry, Spence.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Not good enough. I was waiting in the park playing football solo for an hour! I can't tackle myself!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I know, I know. Something came up. I... I couldn't be outside...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `Still` not good enough. You waste my time, you disrespect me.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Still[/i][/color] not good enough. You waste my time, you disrespect me.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Look, I... I had to look after Hamlet, okay?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You couldn't meet me at `the park` because of your `dog?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You couldn't meet me at [color=#e23b3b][i]the park[/i][/color] because of your [color=#e23b3b][i]dog?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh, well, actually they say when you first adopt a dog, you should take it home immediately.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No, they don't!
Owen shoots Erik and $ALLISON a quick, pleading look.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It's especially important during the `12th` hour that they be off the `street...`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's especially important during the [color=#e23b3b][i]12th[/i][/color] hour that they be off the [color=#e23b3b][i]street...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Owen's trying to tell us something! 12th? Street? He must have been avoiding the park because the 12th Street gang was there!
Erik is the first to react.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh, yep! They have to get accustomed to... Your scent... Which incidentally is pleasantly close to strawberries...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Dogs do smell good.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I mean... They have powerful noses.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But, still, I've never heard about this taking-the-dog-home thing!
Owen looks at $ALLISON, his eyes pleading...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Ahem. I can confirm that dogs need to be brought home. It's so the dog can...
